grand_ole_opry.name: Grand Ole Opry
grand_ole_opry.price_text: Tickets vary by show and seat; check the official site for current prices
grand_ole_opry.hours: Show nights vary; box office and backstage tours run most days — check on the day
grand_ole_opry.tip: Book tickets well ahead for weekend shows, and arrive early for the pre-show photo walk.

ryman.name: Ryman Auditorium
ryman.price_text: Self-guided tour and show prices vary; check the official site
ryman.hours: Daily, roughly 09:00–16:00 for tours; evening shows on many nights — check on the day
ryman.tip: Take the daytime tour to stand on the famous stage, then come back for a show if you can.

vanderbilt.name: Vanderbilt University
vanderbilt.hours: Campus grounds open daily; buildings have their own hours
vanderbilt.tip: Walk the main quad and the tree-lined paths; it is a calm break from Broadway.

captain_ds.name: Captain D's
captain_ds.price_text: Budget fast-food seafood; check local menu prices
captain_ds.hours: Varies by branch — check on the day
captain_ds.tip: A cheap, quick seafood meal; several branches around town, so pick the one nearest you.

carls_jr.name: Carl's Jr. / Hardee's
carls_jr.price_text: Budget fast food; check local menu prices
carls_jr.hours: Varies by branch — check on the day
carls_jr.tip: Fast burgers and breakfast; handy when you need a quick stop between sights.

hunt_brothers.name: Hunt Brothers Pizza
hunt_brothers.price_text: Budget pizza; check local menu prices
hunt_brothers.hours: Varies by host store — check on the day
hunt_brothers.tip: Often inside convenience stores; good for a cheap slice on the go.

broadway.name: Broadway honky-tonk strip
broadway.price_text: Free to walk; drinks and cover charges vary by bar
broadway.hours: Bars busiest from afternoon into late night
broadway.tip: Live music starts early in many bars; walk in, listen, and tip the band.

country_hall.name: Country Music Hall of Fame and Museum
country_hall.price_text: Admission varies; check the official site
country_hall.hours: Daily, roughly 09:00–17:00 — check on the day
country_hall.tip: Allow two to three hours; the gold records and stage costumes are the highlights.

johnny_cash.name: Johnny Cash Museum
johnny_cash.price_text: Admission varies; check the official site
johnny_cash.tip: Compact and busy; go early to avoid the midday crowd.

parthenon.name: The Parthenon and Centennial Park
parthenon.price_text: Park free; museum admission varies — check the official site
parthenon.hours: Park open daily; museum hours vary — check on the day
parthenon.tip: A full-size Greek temple in a city park; great for a picnic and photos.

gulch_walk.name: The Gulch neighbourhood walk
gulch_walk.hours: Always open; shops and cafes have their own hours
gulch_walk.tip: See the famous 'What Lifts You' wings mural and stop for coffee between shops.

east_nashville.name: East Nashville neighbourhood walk
east_nashville.price_text: Free to walk; food and drinks extra
east_nashville.hours: Always open; cafes and bars have their own hours
east_nashville.tip: Wander Five Points for coffee, vintage shops and local restaurants away from the crowds.

food_hall.name: Nashville food hall (check current options)
food_hall.hours: Mostly lunch and dinner daily — check on the day
food_hall.tip: Good for groups: everyone picks their own stall, then share a table.

pedal_tavern.name: Pedal tavern or golf-cart city tour
pedal_tavern.price_text: Prices vary by operator; book ahead
pedal_tavern.hours: Tours run through the day and evening — check on the day
pedal_tavern.tip: A fun way to see the downtown sights; confirm what is included before booking.

riverfront.name: Cumberland Riverfront and pedestrian bridge
riverfront.tip: Walk the bridge at sunset for skyline views and a quiet break from Broadway.

biscuit_breakfast.name: Biscuit and Southern breakfast spot
biscuit_breakfast.hours: Mostly breakfast and lunch — check on the day
biscuit_breakfast.tip: Go early; popular biscuit places get long lines by mid-morning.

hot_chicken.name: Hot chicken lunch
hot_chicken.hours: Lunch and dinner — check on the day
hot_chicken.tip: Order mild if unsure; Nashville hot chicken is genuinely spicy.

listening_room.name: Songwriter listening room or small venue
listening_room.price_text: Cover or ticket prices vary; check the venue
listening_room.tip: Quieter than Broadway bars; a good way to hear original songs up close.

centennial_park.name: Centennial Park walk
centennial_park.hours: Open daily from morning to evening
centennial_park.tip: A lake, lawns and the Parthenon in one stop; good for a slow afternoon.

music_row_walk.name: Music Row walk
music_row_walk.tip: Pass the recording studios and music offices; a short, quiet stroll for music fans.

gulch_food.name: The Gulch restaurants and bars
gulch_food.price_text: Moderate to higher; prices vary by place
gulch_food.hours: Lunch through late evening — check on the day
gulch_food.tip: Book ahead for dinner on weekends; the area fills up fast.

east_coffee.name: East Nashville coffee and vintage shops
east_coffee.hours: Mostly daytime — check on the day
east_coffee.tip: Pair coffee with a browse of the vintage and record shops nearby.

opry_mills.name: Opry Mills shopping and dining
opry_mills.price_text: Free to enter; pay per shop
opry_mills.hours: Daily, roughly 10:00–20:00 — check on the day
opry_mills.tip: Handy before or after an Opry show; plenty of food options under one roof.
